data.one_liner: A full featured library for writing and running Dart benchmarks.
data.what_it_does: Provides a standard way of writing and running benchmarks in Dart with support for groups, setup, and teardown functions. Includes a command-line executable to automatically run benchmarks.
use_when: You want to measure the performance of specific Dart code snippets or functions.
You need grouping and setup/teardown capabilities for organizing benchmarks.
avoid_when: You are looking for UI widget testing or golden tests.
strengths: Clean syntax inspired by the test package and benchmark_harness.
Supports groups, setUp, tearDown, setUpEach, and tearDownEach.
Includes a built-in command line runner for execution.
data.setup_notes: Add benchmark to dependencies and run using pub run benchmark.
